question: Does the P4CL transferable phase signal survive exact per-sample projection back to the fixed P4BS Thomas power spectrum on wholly new archival sources?

dataset.selection_rule: Sort eligible first clips with ten PNG frames and select indices 12 through 15, excluding all twelve P4CJ/P4CL source identities.
dataset.download_destination_rule: caller-owned scratch outside the unavailable repository data junction

patch_observation.residual_normalization: subtract mean and divide by population RMS

candidate.name: phase_projected_compound_thomas_v1
candidate.construction: form the exact P4CL bounded compound field, retain its Fourier phase, replace every non-DC Fourier magnitude with the fixed P4BS Thomas magnitude, inverse transform, zero-mean and unit-RMS normalize
candidate.feature_distance: RMS feature-median difference scaled by the fixed Gaussian-control MAD floor 1e-6

branch_rule.pass: Retain phase-projected compound Thomas as a generic high-order research mechanism and open a disjoint photographic severe-artifact stress only.
branch_rule.fail: Close the exact projected mechanism without changing inherited scale, projection, sources, features or gates.

forbidden: fit any parameter on the four confirmation sources
read source pixels before candidate and Gaussian control statistics are frozen
change the inherited P4CL parameter, projection, source roles, features or 20 percent gate
claim stock, emulsion, scanner, process or physical calibration
integrate the P4BZ-closed photographic hybrid regardless of outcome
claim_ceiling: Fresh-source archival-code phase-structure evidence only; no stock, physical calibration, scanner separation, visual safety or product claim.
